name: Tyukod (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and grey triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tyukod (a red and blue shield with bars and a cockerel, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name TYUKOD in red.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
